releaseNotes.zh-Hans: 新增 Google Gemini 对话服务，更新聊天模型目录，并保留独立的图片服务。已有配置保持不变。
releaseNotes.en: Adds Google Gemini conversation service, refreshes chat model candidates and keeps image services separate. Existing configurations are preserved.

privacy.zh-Hans: 本包不包含 API 密钥、令牌或带凭据的地址；凭据只保存在已批准的凭据存储中。
privacy.en: This package contains no API keys, tokens or credential-bearing URLs; credentials live only in approved credential storage.

description.zh-Hans: OpenAI Responses 线协议，支持推理强度与思考控制。
description.en: OpenAI Responses wire protocol with reasoning-effort and thinking controls.

description.zh-Hans: OpenAI Chat Completions 兼容线协议，多数兼容网关使用该格式。
description.en: OpenAI Chat Completions compatible wire protocol used by most compatible gateways.

description.zh-Hans: Anthropic Messages 线协议，支持思考预算与强度字段。
description.en: Anthropic Messages wire protocol with thinking budget and effort fields.

notes.zh-Hans: 套餐网关不提供 /models 候选列表；聊天与图片候选仅来自已审阅目录。图片候选只包含套餐支持的 Seedream 5.0 Pro / Flash。本轮不提供套餐视频入口。
notes.en: The plan gateway exposes no /models candidate listing; chat and image candidates come only from the reviewed catalog. The image offer contains only plan-supported Seedream 5.0 Pro/Flash. No plan video entry is offered in this update.

notes.zh-Hans: Token Plan 使用独立的套餐地址与凭据；聊天、图片和视频候选仅来自已审阅目录，不声明 /models 列表。
notes.en: Token Plan uses its own plan endpoint and credentials; chat, image and video candidates come only from the reviewed catalog and claim no /models listing.

notes.zh-Hans: 仅用于图像生成，使用原生 generateContent 图像契约。
notes.en: Image generation only, using the native generateContent image contract.

catalogNotice.zh-Hans: 目录包含 models.dev 基线与经审阅的官方对话、套餐和媒体条目；套餐条目不声明模型刷新。目录不含密钥，并经应用内校验后生效。
catalogNotice.en: Includes the models.dev baseline and reviewed official conversation, plan and media entries. Plan entries claim no model listing. The catalog contains no keys and activates after app validation.
